ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (Agreement") made as of the 15th day of May, 2019 by and between 70 Lenox Road Owners Corp., a New York cooperative housing corporation with an office at c/o Maxx Properties, 600 Mamaroneck Avenue, 5th Floor, Harrison, New York 10528 ("Owner"), and Pulse Bedford Development LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1449 37th Street, Suite 216, Brooklyn, New York 11218 ("Developer"). (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter individually referred to WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, generally known by the street address 70 Lenox Road, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lot 37 in Block 5083 on the Tax Map of the County of Kings, City and State of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called      s  s s  , m thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the "OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, generally known by the street addresses 94 Lenox Road and 100 Lenox Road, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lot 48 in Block 5083 and Lot 50 in Block 5083 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein called the “Developer Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct the Developer Building on the Developer Land, which development will have a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land was tobe consideredaseparate andindependent zoninglot; WHEREAS, there are certain Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the Owner Land as of the date hereof that are in excess of the Utilized Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (hereinafter referred to as the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights");
